title: Glenna C NDE 5367
content: I had open heart surgery, and even though I had died on the table, and even though things were just not feeling right to me, I was sent home. The next morning, my husband had to go to work, so I stayed in bed. I guess something woke me up – and then after a few minutes, I had this really sharp pain. It was just not going away – I could not even breathe. I'm telling you, this pain was so great that I knew I was having a heart attack!!! I could not even reach the phone to call for help. ‘This is it,’ I thought. ‘I'm going to die here by myself.’ The pain was getting worse and worse, and soon I could not even breathe. Then there was this really bright light. I had never seen anything like it before! It was so soft! I was drawn to it. I remember there was this guy whose face I could not see. I knew him, and he knew who I was. As I looked around, I saw people sitting in this room that was like a tunnel. They all knew who I was, but I didn't know them. Either that or I could not tell who they were, for they had no faces, or maybe their faces were just in shadow from the bright light. They were talking to me, asking me questions, asking me why don't I just stay here – but I told them that I had too many things to take care of. I said that I had people that needed me and were counting on me, and I just could not stay. Then the guy asked me if I was sure, I didn't want to stay there. I said no – but, I must say, I had never felt as peaceful as I felt there – so happy. Hearing these people talking, I felt like I was home – like I was a child again. Then the guy told me that I really was not ready to be there. He said that I had something to do, and when I do it, I will come back here and be home again. I asked him, ‘What is it that I am supposed to do?’ He did tell me, but I can't remember what it was, except that it was important that I do it. I really hated to leave such a peaceful place! And, Oh! – The light was still there! It had never gone away since I had arrived there. This happened to me a few years ago. Since then, I've had breast cancer and have died again – 4 times – on the operating table. ONE of those times, I saw that light again, but it was like only for a minute, and I was back again. To this day, I still remember it so clearly, like it was yesterday. I can even remember the guy's voice. I've thought about this so many times, asking myself whether this could have been just a dream. (Oh, yes, and that day that I had a heart attack and was rushed to the hospital—I was there for about 2 weeks.) I guess I still have not done whatever I am supposed to do. But I do know that I *will* be home again...and at peace.

arrival.other_being_detail: A 'guy whose face I could not see' who spoke with her; and other people in a room 'like a tunnel' whose faces were not visible/in shadow.

environment.environment_other_detail: A room 'like a tunnel' with people sitting there; a very bright, soft light present.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: The 'guy' said she 'had something to do' and would come back when she did it; he told her what it was, but she could not remember it except that it was important.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Open heart surgery; later describes a heart attack at home the next morning after being sent home, and later breast-cancer-related operations with reported deaths on the table.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: A group of unidentified people without visible faces in a tunnel-like room asked her to stay; she declined; a guide-like 'guy' said she wasn't ready and had something to do.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Bright light appeared first; then she was drawn to it and found herself in a tunnel-like room with people and an unseen-faced 'guy'; conversation about staying/returning; then return.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Later, during one of multiple subsequent operating-table deaths, she saw the light again briefly ('only for a minute').

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Faces of beings/people could not be seen (in shadow or absent); the setting was described as a room that was like a tunnel with people sitting in it.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Hearing these people talking, I felt like I was home – like I was a child again.” / “Then the guy told me that I really was not ready to be there. He said that I had something to do, and when I do it, I will come back here and be home again.”
